subject.title: Mac node approvals reject fractional usage timestamps

question: Should maintainers proceed with the open linked PR for this protected Gateway/Mac approval timestamp mismatch, or choose a different owner path?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and narrow, but the issue is protected by the `maintainer` label and already has an open linked PR, so cleanup automation should not close it or queue a separate fix.

options.title: Review Linked PR
options.body: Keep this issue open and review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102688 as the candidate fix for the schema/test mismatch.

options.title: Choose Another Owner Path
options.body: Leave this issue maintainer-owned and replace or close the linked PR only if maintainers want a different protocol boundary or validation shape.

recommendation.title: Review Linked PR
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102688 as the candidate fix for the schema/test mismatch.
